Serrated_Shark_Jaws.description: Enveloped in the relentless thrashing of the abyssal waters, the Serrated_Shark_Jaws component is a fearsome cephalon, its razor-sharp teeth slicing through the dark depths with unmatched ferocity, each bite imbued with the power to both crush and drain life, leaving foes bleeding profusely and in constant fear of the next strike.

Crushing_Moray_Eel_Maw.description: The Crushing Moray Eel Maw is a fearsome piscine cephalon, its gaping maw lined with razor-sharp teeth and reinforced with powerful muscles, capable of delivering bone-crushing bites and relentless grapples that leave prey struggling in its implacable grip.

Needle_Toothed_Anglerfish_Maw.description: The Needle-Toothed Anglerfish Maw is a fearsome cephalic appendage, bristling with razor-sharp teeth that gleam with an eerie, otherworldly light, granting its bearer heightened perception and a biting attack imbued with arcane power, while also bestowing a measure of cunning and agility.

Venomous_Viperfish_Fangs.description: Emerging from the stygian depths of the abyssal realm, the Venomous Viperfish Fangs are razor-sharp predatory weapons, dripping with a venom so potent it can cloud the minds and cripple the bodies of the unwary, their dark, piscine heritage granting agility and resilience to those who wield them.

Suction_Feeding_Grouper_Maw.description: The Suction Feeding Grouper Maw is a grotesque piscine cephalon, its massive, gaping jaws lined with razor-sharp teeth that can bite with crushing force, enhanced by its powerful muscles that also grant it the ability to pull prey and foes into its maw with terrifying ease.

Filtering_Manta_Ray_Mouth.description: Enveloped in a veil of shimmering scales, the Filtering Manta Ray Mouth is a mesmerizing cephalic marvel, its piscine form imbued with a keen magical perception that grants it an uncanny awareness of its surroundings, allowing it to sense even the faintest whispers of arcane energy.

Beaked_Parrotfish_Maw.description: The Beaked Parrotfish Maw, a fearsome piscine cephalon, boasts a beak-like structure perfect for rending flesh and armor alike, enhancing both the wearer's strength and natural defenses, while granting the lethal skills of Bite and Sunder.

Electric_Eel_Shocking_Maw.description: This creature's electrifying maw, a fearsome cephalon bristling with piscine grace, unleashes bolts of lightning with each lethal bite, its agility and wisdom heightened to reflect hostile spells back upon their caster.

Ghost_Koi_Spectral_Maw.description: The Ghost Koi Spectral Maw is a spectral cephalopod-like entity with a gaping piscine maw, capable of biting through the veil of reality with an otherworldly presence that instills fear and allows it to move unseen, its ethereal form granting it the uncanny ability to see beyond the physical world.

Heavy_Coelacanth_Crushing_Jaws.description: Enveloped in gnarled, chitinous armor, the Heavy Coelacanth Crushing Jaws is a formidable piscine cephalon with a maw that exudes raw strength and unyielding power, its bite capable of sundering even the toughest of armors.
